EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice Under Section 7
My Ref. No.: THI/LND/L2/ACQUI/155.

Land Ministry’s Ref. No. : 4-3/6/2019/HW/119. I hereby give notice, under Sub section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following lands, which are required for a public purpose :

Description of the lands to be acquired : Lot Nos. 01-14 (No. of Lots 14) allotments in total extent of about 0.0122 Hectare, of land in Cadastral Map No. 820155 Block No. 02 Sheet No. 01, situated in the Grama NIladhari Division of No. 334 Yatiyana, in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Thihagoda in Matara District in the Southern Province.
01. Lot No. 01 Name of the Land : Amunugodamulana; Description : Open Waste Land; Original Claimant : Prasanna Dias Jayasekara, Lihiniya Tile Factory, Yatiyana. Extent : 0.0006 Hectare.
02. Lot No. 02 Name of the Land : —; Description : Canal; Original Claimant : Original Claimant cannot be found. Extent: 0.0009 Hectare.

land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
D. H. U. Sandamali, Divisional Secretary, Thihagoda. At Thihagoda Divisional Secretariat. 13th March, 2024 EOG 03 - 0137
AMENDMENT
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice Under Section 7
Land Ministry’s Ref. No. : 4-3/6/2015/HW/82.

My Ref. No.: DSWA/LND/4/ACQUI/35. No. 2260/44 and published on page 1A of the Extraordinary Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka dated 28.12.2021, the land located at F.V.P. 215 of Radaniara Village, No. 570, Radaniara Grama Niladhari Diision, Walasmulla Divisional Secretariat Division of Hambantota District in the Southern Province and published on page 2A of Buwellagoda Village, No. 569, Agalabada Grama Niladhari Division, the notice published in connection with the acquisition of the land located at F.V.P. 156 was cancelled, and the new compensation test venue, date and time will be held at the Divisional Secretariat of Walasmulla on the 26th June, 2024 at 10.00 a.m. hereby declare that it should be amended.
Kumudu C. Lokuhewagama, Divisional Secretary, Walasmulla. At Walasmulla Divisional Secretariat. 05th March, 2024 EOG 03 - 0138
